customAudit.title: Property Assessment System Analysis
customAudit.subtitle: Review of County Assessment Practices & Statewide Reform Efforts

executiveSummary.overview: Analysis of Northampton County property assessment practices in context of statewide litigation challenging Pennsylvania's lack of uniform reassessment standards.
keyFindings: PA has no mandatory periodic reassessment - 70% of counties using outdated assessments
Statewide lawsuit filed demanding uniform standards across all 67 counties
Most PA reassessments result from litigation, not proactive policy
Northampton County median property tax: $3,319/year (129th highest nationally)
executiveSummary.policyImplications: Assessment system creates potential inequities between property owners

findings.title: Statewide Assessment System Challenge
findings.description: Community Justice Project (Pittsburgh) filed suit in Commonwealth Court demanding Pennsylvania establish uniform standards for property reassessments across all 67 counties. Approximately 70% of PA counties have extremely outdated property assessments.

details.allegation: Unfair and regressive assessments due to outdated values

findings.title: Northampton County Assessment Statistics
findings.description: Northampton County property assessment and tax statistics.

findings.title: Legislative Reform Proposals
findings.description: State Senator Wayne Fontana announced plans (January 2025) to introduce legislation moving Pennsylvania to a cyclical reassessment system, as used in nearly every other state.
findings.implication: Could require Northampton County to conduct countywide reassessment

assessmentOffice.appeals: Right to appeal to Tax Assessor's Office

countySpecific.concern: If using outdated base year, assessments may not reflect current market values

equityAnalysis.issue: Without periodic reassessment, newer homebuyers may pay disproportionately higher taxes compared to long-term owners in appreciating areas
equityAnalysis.litigationRisk: Growing legal challenges to non-uniform assessment practices

controllerFlags.description: Assessment system may create inequities - monitor statewide litigation outcome
controllerFlags.requiredAction: Track Commonwealth Court case; prepare for potential mandated reassessment

recommendations: Document date of last countywide reassessment for transparency
Monitor Commonwealth Court litigation on uniform standards
Prepare fiscal impact analysis for potential mandated reassessment
Review assessment equity across property classes
Enhance public communication on appeal rights and processes
